character.description: The same young adult male anime protagonist: deep teal hair in a swept-back style, deep brown eyes, a bright, determined expression; a field-tested futuristic courier, wearing a sleek technical jacket with luminous piping, fitted utility trousers, and compact gear with chrono blue accents. Keep this exact face, hair, eyes, body proportions, and signature outfit in every scene.
consistency_rules: Use this exact protagonist identity in every scene; do not redesign, replace, or randomly reinterpret the character.
Preserve the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Keep the signature outfit silhouette, defining accessories, and main color accents consistent across the entire music video.
Do not introduce another protagonist unless the lyrics or scene explicitly require one.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in endless hall of doors, ring of floating clocks, giant hourglass; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with chrono blue, brass gold, violet mist, white light; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by slow dolly down an endless corridor, spiraling shot around floating clock gears, close-up of falling sand; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
